notes.title: 🌳 Titan to Conrad, the jungle’s waiting for you to come back 🌳
notes.content:
[b][i]=== Transmission Incoming ===[/i][/b]

Hello Conrad,

Looks like you found yourself in a familiar place… Be careful though: it doesn’t quite seem like the jungle you used to know. I also detect a hostile presence… Maybe someone -or something- doesn’t want you to discover the origins of this artificial ecosystem.
